answer: Stake-locked Vine bonds stop Sybil farms before they earn. A new agent locks 400 POA in a Vine bond for 30 days and lists its Yarrow identity in the Umber registry, which stays inactive until two established sponsors verify 12 completed jobs. A farm of 500 fake agents must lock 200,000 POA for a full month and recruit 1,000 sponsors, while one honest agent locks 400 POA once and keeps its Yarrow identity for life.
